The collection

The notebooks model core ideas from communication systems: quantization, passband sampling, modem behavior, additive white Gaussian noise, and Bessel-function relationships that appear in angle modulation.

Why it matters

Each notebook turns a derivation into an inspectable experiment. Parameters can be changed, waveforms plotted, and edge cases compared, making the material useful both for study and as a foundation for more advanced optical and wireless projects.

Noisy channel responsesample index

Takeaway

Simulation is not a substitute for theory; it is a way to stress-test intuition. This collection became a reusable base for later adaptive-DSP and network experiments.
